messages.subject: Using downloadHandler with custom HTML
parts:
Hi

I want to allow users to download data from my app using the provided downloadHandler. Documentation on how to integrate it with a custom build HTML page is a bit lacking though. Is the download "button" restricted to <a> elements (I'm currently using a div containing an svg element). My current setup looks like this (and it doesn't work):

In index.html:

<div id="saveResults" class="shiny-download-link">...</div>

in server.R

output$saveResults <- downloadHandler("results.RDS", function(file) {saveRDS(data, file)})

But this is only based on what I could read from the source code of the file download example.

best wishes

Thomas

best
